mutant.description: Two mutants run against scratch copies of ROW_STRUCTURE.md (never against the committed file) to prove AC1 and AC2 CAN fail. Mutant A: truncated the file to its first 5 lines (frontmatter only, before the delta vocabulary appears) and re-ran AC1's exact invocation. Mutant B: case-insensitively replaced every 'per row' with 'per-item' and re-ran AC2's exact invocation.
mutant.expected: Mutant A must drop AC1's count below 3. Mutant B must drop AC2's count to 0, below the required 1.
mutant.observed: Mutant A: grep -c -E 'worse|better|unchanged' on the 5-line truncation returned 0 (rc=1, no match) -- would FAIL AC1's >=3 bound. Mutant B: grep -c -i 'per row' on the substituted copy returned 0 (rc=1, no match) -- would FAIL AC2's >=1 bound. Both mutants fired as designed.
